problem: Production could publish Dutch content under /en/* because STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=0 and STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 allowed localized route generation to fall back to untranslated source when the immutable English cache was incomplete.
root_cause: The fail-closed production cache requirement had been relaxed while network translation remained disabled. A volatile version timestamp also entered the translation corpus, making a fully deterministic cache impossible without excluding build metadata.
prevention: Production uses STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 together.
The immutable English cache must be complete against the exact post-build public source before merge.
Volatile build metadata such as the visible version timestamp is marked data-bg-no-translate and translate=no.
English route correctness is proven by mobile NL→EN→NL browser readback, including the pricing H1.
Do not publish a Dutch /en/* fallback; incomplete cache must fail the build instead.

evidence.failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1

evaluation.expected_invariant: production English routes are generated only from a complete immutable cache, volatile build metadata is excluded, and /en/prijzen never renders the Dutch pricing H1
